criteria.criterion: Given tracker A and later normal write B, a run pinned to A returns byte/state-identical ticket reads while live writes continue, without materializing the full ticket tree.
Any ticket requested at runtime loads from A and extends the receipt; missing returns not-found-at-A plus a negative dependency, never live fallback.
Direct/transitive hierarchy and inbound/outbound relation predicates invalidate on relevant create/remove/reparent/relink changes; a proven unrelated mutation remains valid.
Alias/Jira/global binding resolution is pinned to A; relevant binding changes invalidate. Unsupported queries fail closed.
Completion code evidence remains bound to separately resolved `code_oid`; tests reject swapped code/ticket roots.

LLM work, lazy reads, receipt validation, preparation, and push occur outside the write lock. Only final HEAD/status assertions, ordering/signing, staging, and one commit are inside; wait/hold are measured.
A successful close creates exactly one local commit containing PASS `COMPLETION_VERDICT`, `STATUS in_progress -> closed`, and completion `SIGNATURE`, all bound to one run/code/receipt identity.
Fault injection at signing, staging, index, and commit boundaries leaves prior HEAD/status and no committed sidecar/signature; retry creates at most one equivalent bundle.
Two parallel reviews cannot publish mixed artifacts: one wins; the loser recognizes an equivalent close or restarts without leaving PASS. Unrelated reviews may both commit after revalidation.
Non-ancestor state, relevant receipt drift, and remote fast-forward rejection fail closed without force; unrelated descendant deltas can revalidate/retry.
Derived caches are OID/schema-keyed with per-run temporaries and do not write inside the pinned view.
